subject: proj-dy
title: PROJ.DY.------WO.EXP.PRI.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 357 (PMBA-21). PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) is the subject; WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) is the partner. From the subject: INFO-DY, EXT-FT (extended functionalism) and TR-INFO (trans-information). From INFO-DY: LK-IMP (linkage implications). From EXT-FT: TECH-DY (technological dynamics). From TECH-DY: EXP-CONT-2 (expansion condition (isolated focus)). From TR-INFO: MT-RT-SIGN and STF (source transfer). From STF: PROG-SIGN (progressional significance). From PROG-SIGN: AF-DY (affinity dynamics).
